# Archive

Older scripts that have been superseded or no longer fit the active
toolset. Kept for reference only — not installed by default.

Folder: [`archieves/`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/tree/main/archieves)

| File | Replaced by / Notes |
|---|---|
| `RefreshEnv.cmd` | Older environment-refresh helper |
| `SetMyPath.cmd` | Earlier PATH-bootstrap script |
| `doskeys.cmd` (archived) | Predecessor to current root-level `doskeys.cmd` |
| `fileorganizer.cmd` / `fileorganizerREVERT.cmd` | Folder reorganizer + undo |
| `initiateShutdown.cmd` | Manual shutdown wrapper |
| `remindme.cmd` | Reminder utility (superseded by `logger.cmd`) |
| `gitinit.backup.cmd` | Backup of an older `gitinit.cmd` |
